answer_1.quote: We treat entity matching as a conditional text generation task... We elicit "reasoning" alongside outputs for entity matching tasks from massive LLMs, and use this to train a modestly sized LM...
answer_1.outputs: binary match label ("Match"/"Not") and natural language explanation (rationale) for each entity pair

answer_4.quote: We collected three annotations per instance and take the majority vote as reference... We use the Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) sandbox as our preferred annotation platform...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked two questions: (1) Is the explanation fully derivable from the input entities and their corresponding matching label? (Intrinsic Errors) (2) Does the explanation contain information in excess of the entity descriptions and their corresponding matching labels? (Extrinsic Errors)
